rows.name: Birthday
rows.descriptionMd: Birthdays are the occasion we are asked for most, and the one where the date is not negotiable. Pick the delivery day, order before the cutoff shown for the destination, and add a card in your own words. Bright tulips, gerberas and mixed bunches are the usual choice; an orchid if the recipient keeps plants. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Birthday flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Pick the delivery day, order before the destination's cutoff and add a card. Tulips, gerberas, mixed bunches and orchids for a birthday.

rows.name: Anniversary
rows.descriptionMd: An anniversary delivery is usually a surprise, so we favour flowers that arrive ready: roses or lilies in a vase, or peonies in season. Choose the date and we hold it. If the recipient is at work, a vase arrangement saves them hunting for one, and the card can be sealed. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Anniversary flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Roses or lilies in a vase and peonies in season, delivered on the date you choose. A vase arrangement saves hunting for one.

rows.name: Love and romance
rows.descriptionMd: Red roses are what most people send, and we keep the list short because this is not an occasion for a lucky dip. Twelve, eighteen or twenty-four stems, or peonies in their few weeks. Valentine's Day has its own cutoff and its own surcharge, both shown before you pay rather than after. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Romantic flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Red roses in twelve, eighteen or twenty-four stems, and peonies in season. Valentine's cutoffs and surcharges shown before you pay.

rows.name: Congratulations
rows.descriptionMd: A new job, an exam, a flat, a company: flowers that can sit on a desk without a vase suit it, so several of these are arranged in a pot or a box. Bright colour rather than pastel. Delivery to an office needs a company name and a floor, which we ask for at checkout. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Congratulations flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Bright bouquets and desk arrangements that need no vase, for a new job, an exam or a company. Office deliveries need a name and floor.

rows.name: New baby
rows.descriptionMd: Flowers for a new baby are sent to a home or a maternity ward, and both have rules. We keep scent low, tie them light, and offer a soft toy that is new and tagged. For a ward, give us the ward name; some do not accept flowers at all, so it is worth a call first. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: New baby flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Low-scent, light bouquets for a home or maternity ward, with a new tagged soft toy option. Give us the ward name for hospital delivery.

rows.name: Get well
rows.descriptionMd: Get-well flowers go to hospitals, clinics and sofas. Boxes and pots need no vase, low scent matters in a shared room, and small is often better than large. Freesias, gerberas and pastel mixes are the usual choice. If a ward refuses flowers we will hold the delivery for a home address instead. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Get well flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Box and pot arrangements that need no vase, low in scent and easy to carry. Freesias, gerberas and pastel mixes for a get-well.

rows.name: Sympathy
rows.descriptionMd: Sympathy flowers go to a home or an office in the days after a death; funeral tributes go to a service and are ordered differently. White lilies, white roses and a peace lily are the usual choices. Tell us the date you want and we will not deliver early, which matters more here than anywhere else. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Sympathy flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: White lilies, white roses and peace lilies sent to a home or office after a death, delivered on the date you name, never early.

rows.name: Thank you
rows.descriptionMd: A thank you is easier to say with a card than with a bouquet, so both go together: the card is free and handwritten by our florist. Sunflowers, yellow tulips and freesias read as thank you; red roses do not. Most of this range sits in the middle of our prices. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Thank you flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Sunflowers, yellow tulips and freesias with a free handwritten card. Mid-range prices, delivered on the date you choose.

rows.name: I am sorry
rows.descriptionMd: When you are apologizing, quiet beats grand and early beats late. Pale roses, white tulips and freesias are the right register, and the card matters more than the flowers — write it yourself and we will have it written out by hand. Order by the cutoff shown for the destination and it arrives on the date you pick. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Apology flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Pale roses, white tulips and freesias with a card written out by hand. Quiet rather than grand, and it arrives on the date you pick.

rows.name: Just because
rows.descriptionMd: No occasion, no card required, nothing to remember: a seasonal bunch or a loose mixed bouquet at the lower end of our prices, sent because it is Tuesday. These are the orders our florists like most, because they get to choose what goes in rather than following a picture. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Just because flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Seasonal bunches and loose mixed bouquets at the lower end of our prices, sent for no occasion. Our florist chooses what goes in.

rows.name: Wedding
rows.descriptionMd: We deliver flowers to a wedding as a gift or a table piece, not as a wedding contract: no bridal work, no venue installation, no consultation. White roses, white peonies, lilies and an orchid are what people send to a couple. For anything more, a local florist should be booked directly, months ahead. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Wedding flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: White roses, peonies, lilies and orchids delivered to a wedding as a gift or table piece. We do not take bridal or venue work.

rows.name: Graduation
rows.descriptionMd: Graduation flowers are sent on a fixed day to a home, a hall or a hall of residence, often in a city the sender has never seen. Bright tulips and gerberas photograph well, and a balloon set is not out of place. Give us a phone number for the recipient so the driver can find them on a busy day. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Graduation flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Bright tulips, gerberas and balloon sets delivered to a home or hall on graduation day. A recipient phone number helps the driver.

rows.name: Housewarming
rows.descriptionMd: A new home usually has no vase, so most of this range is arranged in a basket, crate, bowl or pot, or is a plant that will still be there next year. An olive sapling, a peace lily or an anthurium all qualify. Delivery to a new address is easier with a floor and a door code. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Housewarming flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Baskets, crates, bowls and plants for a home with no vase — olive saplings, peace lilies and anthuriums. A door code helps.

rows.name: Retirement
rows.descriptionMd: Retirement flowers are usually a group present sent to an office on the last day, then carried home on a train. Something that survives that trip is the point: a plant, a basket, or a bouquet tied rather than arranged. One card can carry many names — send us the text and our florist writes it out. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Retirement flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Plants, baskets and tied bouquets that survive the journey home from an office. One card can carry many names, written out by hand.

rows.name: Valentine's Day
rows.descriptionMd: Valentine's Day is one date across the whole of Europe and the busiest day of our year. Red roses cost more that week because they cost our florists more, and a surcharge applies on the day itself — both are shown before you pay. Order early: cutoffs move forward that week. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Valentine's Day flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Red roses delivered on 14 February across Europe. Higher seasonal prices and the day's surcharge are shown before you pay. Order early.

rows.name: Women's Day
rows.descriptionMd: The eighth of March is a working, flower-buying holiday in Poland and much of central and eastern Europe, and barely marked elsewhere. Tulips are the traditional gift, single stems and small bunches most of all. A surcharge applies on the day, and cutoffs are earlier than usual. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Women's Day flower delivery — 8 March across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Tulips for 8 March, the flower-buying holiday of Poland and central Europe. Earlier cutoffs and a day surcharge, both shown up front.

rows.name: Mother's Day
rows.descriptionMd: Mother's Day is not one date: it falls in March in the United Kingdom, in May in Germany and Poland, and elsewhere again in other countries. The page for the destination shows the date that applies there, which is the one that matters. Pink and pastel bouquets, lilies and flowering plants are the usual choices. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Mother's Day flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Mother's Day falls on different dates by country; the destination page shows the one that applies. Pink and pastel bouquets and plants.

rows.name: Father's Day
rows.descriptionMd: Father's Day dates differ by country, and the flowers people send differ too: sunflowers, orange and rust bouquets, an olive sapling or an anthurium rather than pastel roses. The destination page carries the local date. A plant is the safer choice if he has never owned a vase. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Father's Day flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Sunflowers, orange bouquets, olive saplings and anthuriums for Father's Day. Dates differ by country; the destination page shows it.

rows.name: Grandparents' Day
rows.descriptionMd: Several countries mark a grandparents' day, on different dates and sometimes separately for grandmothers and grandfathers. Poland keeps two days in January. Long-lasting flowers matter here — carnations, chrysanthemums, an azalea or an orchid — because the visit that follows may be a week later. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Grandparents' Day flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Carnations, chrysanthemums, azaleas and orchids for Grandparents' Day. Dates differ by country and Poland keeps two days in January.

rows.name: Easter
rows.descriptionMd: Easter moves every year and takes the whole week with it: cutoffs shift, markets close on Good Friday and Easter Monday, and Saturday fills first. Spring flowers are the point — mixed and yellow tulips, narcissi, a garden crate. The destination page shows this year's date and the cutoff to order by. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Easter flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Mixed and yellow tulips, narcissi and garden crates for Easter. Dates move each year; the destination page shows the date and its cutoff.

rows.name: All Saints' Day
rows.descriptionMd: The first of November is the largest flower day of the year in Poland and is marked across Catholic Europe. Chrysanthemums are the flower: grave bouquets, wreaths, a cross, a low arrangement in a stone-look pot. Cemetery deliveries need the cemetery name and the plot or section, and cutoffs are days earlier than usual. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: All Saints' Day flower delivery — 1 November
rows.seoDescription: Chrysanthemum grave bouquets, wreaths and crosses for 1 November. Cemetery deliveries need the cemetery name and plot; cutoffs earlier.

rows.name: Christmas
rows.descriptionMd: Christmas deliveries run into a week of closed markets and half-open cities, so cutoffs are earlier than at any other time except All Saints'. White and red bouquets with pine and eucalyptus, a winter table arrangement, an orchid for an office. The destination page shows which December dates are open there and their cutoffs. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Christmas flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: White and red bouquets with pine and eucalyptus, winter arrangements and orchids. Earlier cutoffs; the destination page shows the dates you can pick.

rows.name: New Year
rows.descriptionMd: New Year deliveries are mostly to offices reopening and to homes hosting, in a week when many florists are closed. White bouquets, winter arrangements and plants work better than anything that needs immediate care. Check the destination page for the first date available after the holiday. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: New Year flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: White bouquets, winter arrangements and plants for a reopening office or a home hosting. Check the destination page for the first date after the holiday.

rows.name: Name day
rows.descriptionMd: A name day matters as much as a birthday in Poland and much of central Europe, and is unknown elsewhere. Carnations, a mixed bunch or a modest bouquet is the register — this is a small, frequent gift, not a grand one. Calendars differ by country, so the destination page carries the local one. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Name day flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Carnations, mixed bunches and modest bouquets for a name day, a frequent gift in Poland and central Europe. Local calendars shown.

rows.name: Teachers' Day
rows.descriptionMd: Teachers' Day is marked on different dates by country and is a real flower day in Poland, where it falls in October. Small, modest bunches are the norm, sent by families rather than by schools. Delivery to a school needs the school name and a contact, and reception is usually the safest address. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Teachers' Day flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Small inexpensive bunches for Teachers' Day, a real flower day in Poland. School deliveries need the school name and a contact.

rows.name: Sant Jordi
rows.descriptionMd: The twenty-third of April in Catalonia: a rose and a book, exchanged in the street. Single red roses are the tradition, and demand is concentrated into a single morning. We cover it where we have a florist in the city, and the destination page says whether that is the case this year. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Sant Jordi rose delivery — 23 April in Catalonia
rows.seoDescription: Single red roses for Sant Jordi on 23 April, where we have a florist in the city. Demand is concentrated into one morning.

rows.name: Grandmothers' Day in France
rows.descriptionMd: France marks a grandmothers' day on the first Sunday of March, which is not the same as any other country's grandparents' day. Long-lasting flowers and plants suit it: an azalea, an orchid, carnations, a pastel basket. The destination page carries this year's date for France. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Grandmothers' Day in France — flower delivery
rows.seoDescription: Azaleas, orchids, carnations and pastel baskets for the French grandmothers' day on the first Sunday of March. This year's date shown.

rows.name: May Day lily of the valley
rows.descriptionMd: The first of May in France means lily of the valley, sold on the street and given as a charm. It is a one-day flower with a one-day supply, so where we can source it we say so on the destination page and where we cannot we do not pretend otherwise. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: May Day lily of the valley — 1 May delivery in France
rows.seoDescription: Lily of the valley for 1 May in France, a one-day flower with a one-day supply. The destination page says where we can source it.

rows.name: Confirmation
rows.descriptionMd: Confirmation is a fixed-date family event in Germany, Denmark and Norway, usually on a Sunday in spring, and flowers are sent to the family home before the meal. White and pastel bouquets and a plant that survives the day are the usual choices. Sunday delivery carries a surcharge. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Confirmation flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: White and pastel bouquets and plants for a spring confirmation in Germany, Denmark or Norway. Sunday delivery carries a surcharge.

rows.name: School leaving day
rows.descriptionMd: School leaving celebrations run to a fixed day each year and mostly to a home address, with everyone out by the afternoon. Bright bouquets and balloon sets fit the day; a morning slot fits it better. The destination page shows the local date and the cutoff that goes with it. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: School leaving day flower delivery across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Bright bouquets and balloon sets for a school leaving celebration, delivered to a home in a morning slot. Local dates shown.

rows.name: Grandmother's Day in Estonia
rows.descriptionMd: Estonia keeps its own grandmother's day, and it is not the French or the Polish one. Plants and long-lasting flowers work well here, because the visit and the flowers rarely coincide: an azalea, an orchid, carnations or a pastel basket. The destination page carries the date. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Grandmother's Day in Estonia — flower delivery
rows.seoDescription: Azaleas, orchids, carnations and pastel baskets for the Estonian grandmother's day. Long-lasting choices; the date is shown on the page.

rows.name: Norwegian Constitution Day
rows.descriptionMd: The seventeenth of May is a national day in Norway, spent outdoors in a parade rather than at home. Flowers are sent to a home for the breakfast beforehand, so a morning slot and a bouquet that needs no arranging are the useful combination. The destination page shows whether we cover the city. Every order will be made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Norwegian Constitution Day flower delivery — 17 May
rows.seoDescription: Bouquets delivered to a home for the 17 May breakfast in Norway, in a morning slot and needing no arranging. City coverage shown.
